name: anshi-mvp-place-candidates
coordinateReferenceSystem: OGC:CRS84 (WGS84 longitude, latitude); no reprojection performed
usageBoundary: Curated review evidence. An approved point may enter release data only after the full Place and all other dependencies pass their own gates. It represents a documented modern mapping feature or a reproducible representative point, not a confirmed Tang-period city center.

properties.name: 潼关古城（现代遗址范围代表点候选）
processing: Read the closed coordinate ring referenced by OpenStreetMap way 1195138308 version 3.
Preserve all 67 node references (66 unique nodes); do not clip, simplify, visually trace, or reproject.
Calculate the planar polygon centroid directly in longitude/latitude with the shoelace centroid formula.
Round longitude and latitude to 7 decimal places and verify that the resulting point is inside the source ring.
properties.coordinateNote: The point is the reproducible centroid of a modern OpenStreetMap ruins polygon. The 1992 Tongguan County Gazetteer associates an old-city site on the south bank at the Yellow/Wei confluence with the 691 pass, while a Xinhua report places the Tang city on the Linzhi Plateau. The point therefore does not establish the location of the 755-756 Tang pass.
properties.reviewDecision: Accepted as a visibly disputed modern old-city representative point. It must not be described as the confirmed center of the 755-756 Tang pass.

properties.name: 宝轮寺塔（现代陕州故城内部地标代表点候选）
processing: Read longitude and latitude directly from OpenStreetMap node 12768197183 version 1.
Preserve the source WGS84 / OGC:CRS84 longitude-latitude order.
Do not clip, simplify, reproject, calculate a centroid, create a buffer, or derive a city boundary.
properties.coordinateNote: The point is the fixed OpenStreetMap location of the modern Baolun Temple Pagoda. Henan Archives locates the pagoda in the southeast part of the Shanzhou old city. It is only a modern landmark representative point inside the old-city area, not the confirmed center or boundary of the 755-756 Shanzhou/Shanjun seat.
properties.reviewDecision: Accepted as a visibly disputed modern landmark representative point inside the Shanzhou old-city area. It must not be described as the confirmed center or boundary of the 755-756 Shanzhou/Shanjun seat.
excludedAlternatives: Do not use the modern Shanzhou District government location.
Do not package the CC BY-NC CHGIS coordinate in public GeoJSON.
Do not use the CHGIS prefecture-level hvd_115770 point as a seat coordinate.

properties.name: 应天门（现代遗址展示建筑代表点候选）
processing: Read the closed coordinate ring referenced by OpenStreetMap way 865951589 version 4.
Preserve all 22 node references (21 unique nodes); do not clip, simplify, visually trace, or reproject.
Calculate the planar polygon centroid directly in longitude/latitude with the shoelace centroid formula.
Round longitude and latitude to 7 decimal places and verify that the resulting point is inside the source ring.
properties.coordinateNote: The point is the reproducible centroid of a modern OpenStreetMap building polygon tagged as Yingtian Gate. A National Development and Reform Commission page identifies Yingtian Gate as the south gate of the Sui-Tang Luoyang palace city and describes the modern site presentation project. The point is only a modern heritage-display landmark representative point, not the confirmed center or boundary of Luoyang in 755-756.
properties.reviewDecision: Accepted as a visibly disputed modern Yingtian Gate heritage-display landmark representative point. It must not be described as the center of the 755-756 city, a complete historical boundary, the exact historical gate footprint, or an event location.
excludedAlternatives: Do not use the modern Luoyang city-center point as a substitute for the historical city.
Do not derive a 47-square-kilometer polygon from the official narrative description.
Do not use the modern display-building polygon as the historical gate footprint.

properties.name: 丹凤门（现代大明宫遗址展示地标代表点候选）
processing: Read the closed coordinate ring referenced by OpenStreetMap way 280412702 version 4.
Preserve all 21 node references (20 unique nodes); do not clip, simplify, visually trace, or reproject.
Calculate the planar polygon centroid directly in longitude/latitude with the shoelace centroid formula.
Round longitude and latitude to 7 decimal places and verify that the resulting point is inside the source ring.
properties.coordinateNote: The point is the reproducible centroid of a modern OpenStreetMap building polygon named Danfeng Gate. Official Xi'an local-history and Shaanxi cultural-heritage pages identify Danfeng Gate as part of the Tang Chang'an Daming Palace site and distinguish the heritage-display facility from the ruins. The point is only a modern Daming Palace heritage-display landmark representative point in the northern part of Tang Chang'an, not the confirmed center or boundary of the 755-756 city.
properties.reviewDecision: Approved by banq on 2026-07-31 only as a visibly disputed modern Daming Palace Danfeng Gate heritage-display landmark representative point. It must not be described as the center of the 755-756 city, a complete historical boundary, the exact Tang-period gate footprint, the location where the emperor left the city, or the location where Yan forces entered.
excludedAlternatives: Do not use the modern Xi'an city-center point as a substitute for Tang Chang'an.
Do not use the extant Ming city-wall boundary as the Tang city boundary.
Do not derive a city polygon from the official narrative range description.
Do not use the modern display-building polygon as the Tang-period Danfeng Gate footprint.

properties.name: 稠桑原（现代同名居民点代表点候选）

sourceFeature.provider: 灵宝市城市管理局公示；名辰环境工程有限公司编制
sourceFeature.reportTitle: 灵宝市城乡餐厨垃圾收运转及综合处理项目环境影响报告书（征求意见稿）
sourceFeature.reportLocation: PDF 第 30 页 / 印刷第 25 页，表 2.6-1“稠桑原”行

license.reportCoordinate: 不适用：只引用单项事实数据并保留报告、页码和表号，不复制原表、附图或编排。

processing: 从同一报告选取坡寨村、坡寨村后城子组、原门上、稠桑原、雷家沟村五个现代居民点，以及三个相互接近的厂址坐标作为成组样本。
分别测试原值直接按 EPSG:4326 叠加，以及把原值视为 GCJ-02 后用标准公式迭代转换为 WGS84 的两种假设。
GCJ-02 转换会使八个样本整体西南移约 517.7—518.0 米。
把两组结果叠加到访问日为 2026-07-31 的 Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 导出影像；三个可区分的村庄样本和厂址现场关系支持原值，两个村庄样本记为歧义，没有样本支持 GCJ-02 转换。
不从影像描绘建筑、道路、村界、填埋场边界、战场区域、缓冲区或路线；影像文件不进入仓库。
将报告原数值登记为 OGC:CRS84 候选，不执行 GCJ-02 转换；保留 WGS84 与 CGCS2000 无法通过本次方法区分的残余不确定性。
properties.coordinateNote: 报告原值在多点技术交叉核验中与 EPSG:4326 影像关系一致，GCJ-02 转换假设被排除；但报告没有书面声明 WGS84 或 CGCS2000。本点因此只作为现代同名居民点的 DISPUTED / PENDING_REVIEW 代表点，不是已确认的唐代灵宝西原、秦函谷关旧址或 756 年战场中心。
properties.reviewDecision: `banq` 于 2026-07-31 批准原值 [110.872607, 34.615468] 作为 OGC:CRS84 候选及其技术核验边界；必须保持 DISPUTED，不得描述为唐代灵宝西原、秦函谷关旧址或 756 年战场中心。
excludedAlternatives: 不使用现代灵宝市中心、秦函谷关景区或任一无直接来源的网络 POI 代替该候选。
不从单点生成历史战场范围、精确边界、缓冲区或路线。
不把来源坐标的六位小数解释为已证明的亚米级定位准确度。
